title: Open Source Auto Farm
features:
Simple auto farm to collect sans using fireclickdetector

Note: Wont work on exec that dont support fireclickdetector.

Made by @kylosilly on discord report bugs
script:
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local Sanz = Workspace.NPCs

getgenv().AutoFarm = true -- Set it to false if you want it to stop

while true do
    if getgenv().AutoFarm then
        for i, v in Sanz:GetChildren() do
            if v and v:IsA("Model") and v:FindFirstChild("ClickablePart") and v:FindFirstChild("ClickablePart"):FindFirstChild("ClickDetector") then
                local clickpart = v.ClickablePart.ClickDetector
                fireclickdetector(clickpart)
            end
        end
    end
    task.wait()
end
